domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record found. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits are not public for this entity in accessible sources; zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403 and the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused), so no GST/tender page could be read. Note: the same ImportKey page shows two inbound rows from MOUSER ELECTRONICS (2024-03-08, 2024-04-03, HS 85369090) — these are imports into India, not domestic supply, and are not counted as domestic evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: three dated outbound air shipments from Delhi Air Cargo to Sheremetyevo (Moscow), Russia, on 2024-01-19, 2024-04-05 and 2024-04-18, with bill-of-lading numbers 6863291, 8909709 and 9208152, HS 85369090 and 85366990 (micro-D/D-sub connectors, Glenair part numbers), buyer ELTEK LLC, Office 604, 148 Varshavskoye Shosse, Moscow 117519. Declared HS 853690 matches the observed export HS 85369090 — no correction needed. Business model is a Delhi-based trader/distributor of connectors: it buys from Mouser Electronics (US) and re-exports to Russia, so role is trader rather than manufacturer. Domestic supply: no traces of domestic deliveries found in accessible sources — GST turnover and GeM/CPPP participation could not be verified (registries blocked, search tool down), so recorded as unknown, not as confirmed. Revenue: null (not public). No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here — out of scope for this role.
